decision.rationale: TXN-008150 is a charge of 59.13 EUR on card CRD-000202 at Ashgrove Athletic Club (MER-000063), a merchant that bills on a recurring basis. The charge was made on 2026-09-14 and posted on 2026-09-15. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 39 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The cardholder says they cancelled by phone but has nothing in writing, and no merchant cancellation confirmation is attached. There is therefore no effective cancellation date to compare with the 2026-09-14 charge date. Under recurring-no-proof, the merchant's cancellation records and terms for the subscription must be requested.

proposed_actions.note: Please provide your cancellation records for this cardholder's subscription, including any phone cancellation requests and the dates they took effect, and the subscription terms that applied to the 59.13 EUR charge made on 2026-09-14.
